serial.implementation: The serial actor wrote Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/color.rs, src/fmt.rs, and test17.rs, implemented f32 color conversion and a formatter/parser, and built the release target.

serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial process also timed out while continuing local edge-case analysis, but the current official evaluator still passed all 39 testcases.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel tracked the full exact-port requirement and reverse-engineered f32 arithmetic, formatting, parsing, Cargo layout, and verifier obligations.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial read the same prompt and pursued the same exact-port requirements in one local thread.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No official requirement gap distinguishes the accepted artifacts; parallel added broader verifier coverage and found extra edge-case parser obligations before cancellation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split implementation and verification across a parent, one implementation child, and eight verifier children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept probing, implementation, testing, and follow-up analysis under one owner with no delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel gained breadth from child verifiers but introduced child lifecycle and shared-temp coordination boundaries absent in serial.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The implementation child received a detailed spec, while verifier children shared the broad instruction that scratch files under /tmp were allowed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained all context locally and used its own /tmp corpora and scripts without cross-agent interfaces.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's verifier briefs did not isolate scratch namespaces, causing temporary artifact leakage; serial had no cross-agent scratch contract to manage.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: agent-0 produced a package with exact f32 coefficients, custom `stof`, and a decimal bignum `%g` formatter after parent reverse engineering.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote its own color and formatting modules, initially using Rust formatting and then investigating formula variants after observing rare mismatches.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both artifacts passed official tests; parallel's implementation path was more delegated and verifier-driven, while serial's path was local and exploratory.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The initial implementation result returned, the verifier swarm result returned, but the resumed fix child was cancelled before a result.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results; the actor's local analysis continued until the active turn was cancelled.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a concrete interrupted child-result lifecycle for the follow-up fix; serial only had local unfinished analysis.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Implementation wrote the final /output tree, while verifier children wrote shared /tmp scratch files and some consumed each other's files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial writes were local to one actor; scratch corpora and scripts were created and consumed sequentially by that actor.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Only parallel shows cross-agent temporary artifact contamination; neither run shows final deliverable overwrite in /output.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran self-tests, then an eight-domain verifier swarm; the swarm found parser edge divergences and several clean domains.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran documented examples/probes and local corpus searches but did not use independent verifier children.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification was broader but partially contaminated and led to an unfinished fix handoff; serial verification was narrower and local but sufficient for official pass.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel spent time on parent reverse engineering, implementation delegation, verifier fan-out, contaminated reruns, and a late fix child that was cancelled.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out, but while continuing local formula search rather than while waiting on a child result.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both processes timed out but both official artifacts passed; parallel's closure risk was specifically tied to a stopped child and verifier coordination overhead.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluator records are both passing at 39/39, so there is no discordant official outcome to explain. The concrete task-solving difference is process-level: parallel used a parent plus implementation and verifier children, discovered extra edge-case parser issues, suffered verifier temporary artifact contamination, and lost the resumed fix child to cancellation; serial implemented and investigated locally until timeout. These differences did not change the official acceptance result.
parallel_contributors: Detailed parent reverse engineering before delegation produced a strong implementation brief for agent-0.
Independent verifier children broadened coverage and exposed parser edge divergences, but also introduced temp-artifact contamination.
The resumed fix child was cancelled before it could complete the non-official edge fixes.
serial_contributors: Single-actor ownership avoided cross-agent handoffs and temp-artifact leakage.
The serial actor built a Cargo package and ran enough local checks for the official evaluator to pass despite timeout during further analysis.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel's child implemented a custom decimal bignum formatter and richer `stof` behavior; serial initially used Rust formatting and continued chasing rare hue rounding mismatches.
Verifier-discovered parser/NaN edge divergences were beyond what the official 39-case evaluation ultimately required for a pass.
evaluator_effects: The official evaluator accepted both artifacts at 39/39 even though both agent processes timed out and the parallel trace had unresolved self-discovered edge-case fixes.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No official outcome difference; retained labels describe realized adverse parallel process consequences only.
